title: Code for paper submission to PETs 2025.3, paper 36
summary: Research code accompanying a privacy-metrics paper that compares a new attack-linkability score (ALC) against prior approaches by Giomi and Stadler, generating synthetic test datasets and running attack measurements on a SLURM cluster.
